name: Inkling
description: Notes with Notion-style databases, linked pages, a graph, canvases and live collaboration.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The database (postgres/), uploaded files and plugins (inkling/) and the keys and first signup key (state/). Back up the whole folder.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Inkling web app, API, live editing and MCP, published on host as 6703

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUBLIC_URL
variables.description: The address you open Inkling at, like http://192.168.1.20:6703 or https://notes.example.com. Inkling opens from any address; this one is used in email links, share previews and AI agent (MCP) sign-in. With https, sign-in cookies are marked secure.
